basic_details.job_title: DGHS Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Professor-cum-Principal and Professor-cum-Vice-Principal Posts

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in Nursing, Registered Nurse and Midwife, M.Phil/Ph.D. in Nursing (Desirable)
qualification.details: Professor-cum-Principal: Master's Degree in Nursing from a recognized University; Registered as a Nurse and Midwife with State Nursing Council; Fifteen years' experience with M.Sc. (Nursing) out of which twelve years should be teaching experience with minimum of five years in Collegiate Programme; Three years' experience in administration in Nursing in State or Union Territories or Central Government. Desirable: M.Phil/Ph.D. in Nursing. Professor-cum-Vice-Principal: Master's Degree in Nursing from a recognized University; Registered as a Nurse and Midwife with State Nursing Council; Twelve years' experience with M.Sc. (Nursing) out of which ten years should be teaching experience with minimum of five years in Collegiate Programme; Three years' experience in administration in Nursing in State or Union Territories or Central Government. Desirable: M.Phil/Ph.D. in Nursing.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DGHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DGHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DGHS Recruitment 2026 is 13 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DGHS?
faq.answer: DGHS has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Professor-cum-Principal and Professor-cum-Vice-Principal in the 2026 recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Nursing from a recognized University and be registered as a Nurse and Midwife. M.Phil/Ph.D. in Nursing is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for DGHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Level-13 (₹1,23,100-2,15,900) for Professor-cum-Principal and Level-12 (₹78,800-2,09,200) for Professor-cum-Vice-Principal.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DGHS Professor-cum-Principal and Vice-Principal posts?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Deputation (Including short term contract) and Promotion.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job posting?
faq.answer: The job is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110024.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.
